name: mac-calendar
description: Read, create, and modify the real macOS Calendar and Reminders databases, exposed to Codex as chat-driven tools.

interface.shortDescription: Manage this Mac's Calendar and Reminders from chat
interface.longDescription: Mac Calendar & Reminders drives the native Calendar and Reminders data on this Mac through EventKit. List and create calendars and reminder lists, rename them, set their colours, create, edit, move, duplicate, and delete events and reminders, attach alerts, recurrence rules, priorities, and links, find free time, surface conflicts, and get a merged agenda of events and due reminders. Dates are accepted in plain language, including Chinese. Every mutating tool previews its effect first and refuses to touch read-only or subscribed calendars.
